summary: Two backcountry travelers lost the trail in snow and inclement weather; after a helicopter attempt was impossible due to weather, 11 GCSAR members hiked 14 miles to locate them and escorted them out to the trailhead overnight; the pair's dog Stella ran off during the night egress and was found and brought out by the team lead on Sept 25
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue (mutual aid)
notes: Mission date from GCSAR mission-update post (Sept 20; post images timestamped Sept 2021); dog-return detail Sept 25 same post; Jackson County per post 2026-09-20: merged GCSAR FB post permalink (GCSAR mutual-aid post for the 2021-09-20 Jackson County backpacker search; adds team post ). 2026-09-20: merged GCSAR FB post permalink (9NEWS Stella-the-dog story share; same mission as row 2253 (dog found Sept 25 after runnin).
